notes: Spots are limited. Other high school chances are on the hospital's For High School Students page.
name: High School Summer Volunteer
what_you_do: Summer hospital volunteers welcome visitors at the front desk. They help patients and families pass the time with fun things to do in waiting rooms.
who_can_apply: High school students who are at least 16 by June 1, 2027.
duration: Summer only. No year-round roles for high schoolers.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed. Page says check back in spring 2027.
how_to_apply: Watch the program page in spring 2027 for the application.
